svg.text: PER-OFFICE IP-TRACKER (MODES 2–6) & SCOPE-LOCKED RECONCILIATION (MODES 1, 8, 9, 10)

13 Office & Cross-Office IP Clusters (MJ2026, BIGDAD, CUB22HR, ATEAM...) + Zero-Gap Financial Reconciliation • ID: SD-ARTIFACT-03-IP-AND-RECONCILIATION • Live R2 Portal: https://pub-d061f943df0e4477ba7ff200721eddb1.r2.dev/graph.html
LEFT: PER-OFFICE & CROSS-OFFICE IP-TRACKER (MODES 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
Mode 3 · Per-Office vs. Global Shared-IP Matcher (ip-tracker.js line 78)
• Per-Office Query: POST /cloud/api/Manager/getWebLog { type: "B", agentID: "BILLY666", customerID: "MJ2026" }
-> Returns 5 accounts in MJ2026 on 104.28.34.12 (MJ102, EJ8834, MJ103, EJ8835, MJ101) | Dwell: 4.2s | MFCS: 98/100
• Global Cross-Office Query: POST /cloud/api/Manager/getWebLog { type: "B", agentID: "BILLY666", customerID: "0" }
-> Catches CUB22HR (5x) <-> MAX92/MX920_1 <-> BILLY666/CUST_BAY_1..2 on 104.28.55.19 & LAKERS <-> SOUTHSHORE
All 13 Clusters Active: MJ2026, BIGDAD, CUB22HR, ATEAM, GPRO50RSK, JUICEPLUS, DAN318, MACHR, GOLD22, TEXANS, SPEN, LAKERS, KOBE24
Modes 2, 4 & 5 · Actor/Target Timeline, YYYY-MM-DD IP History & Reverse IP
• Mode 2 (Access Logs): Distinguishes SELF_PLAYER (MJ102 Login @ 14:42:07Z -> Wager @ 14:42:11Z, 4.2s dwell)
from OFFICE_AGENT override (Actor=MJ2026 -> Target=MJ102 @ 14:42:18Z executing Ban-Hammer clamp)
• Mode 4 (Customer IP History, type="C" YYYY-MM-DD): Tracks MJ102 across 3 IP spans, 2 ASN transitions,
and flags 1 collection gap (32.75h > 24h threshold)
• Mode 5 (Accounts by IP, type="I"): 104.28.34.12 -> 5 observed accounts (90 total auth/wager hits)
Mode 6 · Activity Overlap: Concurrent Session Intervals vs. Nearby Point Events
1. CONFIRMED_CONCURRENT_SESSION_OVERLAP (MJ102 [14:40:00Z..14:46:30Z] <-> MJ103 [14:41:10Z..14:45:40Z]):
Bounded session intervals intersect for 270 seconds on 104.28.34.12 -> Clamp entire office ring
2. NEARBY_POINT_EVENTS_WITHOUT_SESSION_OVERLAP (CHURN_059 @ 15:22:48Z <-> CHURN_049 @ 15:23:12Z):
Single bet-ticker point timestamps separated by 24s (0s session overlap) -> Flagged as nearby point window
Prevents false session-overlap accusations when only point-in-time bet timestamps are available
4-Surface Identity Join (F402 + Office + GSLive Partner 118 + Polymarket 0x)
• F402 Customer & Office : https://desk.bookdeskops.com/dashboard?customer=MJ102&agent=MJ2026
• GSLive Partner 118 : https://plive.sportswidgets.pro/manager-tools/#/reports/users?partnerId=118&text=player_MJ102
• Polymarket On-Chain 0x : https://polymarket.com/profile/0x07db5765beba17be154cbfbd6324a15f3c81fa4f
• Write Mutation Wire ID : customerID="MJ102 " (11-char padded) + agentOwner="MJ2026"
RIGHT: RISK EXPOSURE & SCOPE-LOCKED RECONCILIATION (MODES 1, 8, 9, 10)
Mode 1 · Customer Overview & Missing-Data Guardrails
• MJ102 (MJ2026) : Validated Net +$42,850 | Pending Stake $60,600 | Liability $64,120 | Fresh 310s ago (OK)
• BGD101 (BIGDAD) : Validated Net +$89,400 | Pending Stake $73,300 | Liability $85,411 | Fresh 455s ago (OK)
• CB112_1 (CUB22HR): Validated Net +$31,200 | Pending Stake $63,000 | Liability $57,272 | Fresh 368s ago (OK)
• CHURN_059 (LAKERS): Emits STALE_ACCESS_TELEMETRY_54H + WEBLOG_MODE_A_COLLECTION_GAP warnings
Mode 8 · Settled Net (Period & Currency P/L + Free-Play Principal Convention)
Sign Convention: CUSTOMER_PERSPECTIVE_POSITIVE_IS_PLAYER_WIN (Book Hold = -SettledSportsNet)
• Ticket 899101-1 (7D USD, Standard Win, FreePlay="N"): Stake $22,000 -> Won +$20,000
• Ticket 899145-1 (7D USD, FreePlay Win, FreePlay="Y"): Stake $5,000 -> Won +$4,545 (principal excluded)
• Ticket 899210-1 (7D USD, FreePlay Loss, FreePlay="Y"): Stake $3,000 -> Lost $0 cash (Saved $3,000 principal)
Mode 9 · Pending Exposure (Unique Tickets: Stake vs. Potential Payout vs. Liability)
Ingests 4 raw pending rows for MJ102 -> Drops 1 ALERT twin -> Collapses 2 parlay leg rows into 901104-1:
• Ticket 901104-1 (2-Leg Parlay, FreePlay="N"): Stake = $16,200 | Liability = $42,120 | Payout = $58,320
• Ticket 901188-1 (Straight Bet, FreePlay="Y"): Stake = $0 | Liability = $9,500 | Payout = $9,500
SEPARATED TOTALS: Cash Stake = $16,200 | Potential Payout = $67,820 | Defined Liability = $51,620
Mode 10 · Scope-Locked Reconciliation (DailyFigures vs. GradedTickets vs. Ledger)
Identical Scope Lock: 2026-10-25..2026-10-31 (America/Chicago FigureDate Window)
• MJ102 : Report DailyFigures (+$24,545) == Settled Tickets (+$24,545) | Ledger Delta (+$23,045)
Explained Difference: -$1,500 (MANUAL_LEDGER_ADJUSTMENT TXN-ADJ-901 wire settlement fee)
• BGD101: Report DailyFigures (+$89,400) == Settled Tickets (+$89,400) == Ledger Delta (+$89,400)
✅ VERDICT: Unresolved Gap = $0.00 across both accounts (RECONCILED_WITH_EXPLAINED_DIFFS & RECONCILED_EXACT)
